name: meteors
title: Meteors
blurb: Meteors fall vertically with glowing trails and random timing.
description: Renders animated meteors that fall vertically within a container. Each meteor has randomized delay and duration with a CSS-gradient glow trail.
use_when: Background effects for hero sections or cosmic-themed pages where falling meteors add atmospheric drama.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive devices — many animated elements can impact rendering performance.
a11y: Purely decorative animation with no semantic content or interactive elements.
